items.title: [ECG] Invitation to Healthcare Outreach Project 2026 Webinar Series
items.author: Attarwala Khadija Sadiq Husain
items.description:
Dear students,
Are you interested in working in the healthcare sector? Is your dream career to be a nurse or a pharmacist? Or perhaps, have you always aspired to become a doctor or an allied health professional, but you are unsure of what it entails?
Well, fret not! This year, students from NUS Medicine Nursing, Pharmacy, Dentistry and SIT Nursing, Diagnostic Radiography and Radiation Therapy, Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Speech and Language Therapy, Dietetics and Nutrition are collaborating to bring you Healthcare Outreach Project (HOP) 2026 Webinar Series (Part 2)!
HOP 2026 Webinar Series includes a series of webinars that seek to provide you with a broader perspective of the different healthcare courses and careers available in Singapore through sharing sessions by professionals and current university students.
Through these sessions, participants will gain insights into student life, academic pathways, specialisations, career opportunities, and common misconceptions about the field, while hearing firsthand experiences from students about their educational journeys and from professionals about their career development and day-to-day work.
Details of the event are as follows:
HOP 2026 Webinar Series
Venue: Online (Zoom)
Cost: Free!
Date & Time: 5 September 2026 (Saturday)
You may sign up via the link here:
Signup form
Our signups are open from now till 31 Aug 2026 2359! 🕛
5 Sep 2026 (Saturday):
10am to 12pm: Professional speakers
1pm to 3pm: Student speakers
Featuring speakers from: Nursing, Diagnostic Radiography, Dietetics and Nutrition, Occupational Therapy, Radiation Therapy, Physiotherapy and Speech and Language Therapy.
Join our Telegram channel (
HOP Telegram Channel
) / follow our Instagram page(@healthcareoutreachproject) to stay updated!
To find out more about HOP or get updates about our upcoming events, please visit our social media platforms:
Instagram: @healthcareoutreachproject
Facebook: @healthcareoutreachproject
Website: https://healthcareoutreachproject.com
Telegram channel: HOP Telegram Channel
For any enquiries, feel free to drop us an email at nus.hop.main@gmail.com.
We hope to see you at HOP 2026!
Thank you!
Posted bu ECG Unit on behalf of HOP
